items.title: H1 2026 review (L5) — Meets+
items.text: Reviewer: Priya Shah. Wrote RFC-019 'Cloud sandboxes for background agents' (Firecracker microVMs, per-tenant images), adopted by Platform and Security. Growth: delegate more; R-09 risks bottlenecking on Nadia alone.

items.title: Shipped: cloud sandbox alpha with Ostrander Games (R-09)
items.text: First design partner live in us-west-2; 214 background-agent runs/week, 98.6% success. PE-KR4 at 1/5 partners.

items.title: Self-reflection: R-09 is understaffed
items.text: With 1.5 engineers (me + Farah at 50%) I forecast 2-3 design partners by EOQ, not 5. VPC peering, secrets injection, and per-tenant image builds are each ~2 weeks. Sandbox cold start (~9 min) is dominated by re-indexing the repo; a persistent commit-keyed index (R-14/R-01 overlap) would cut it below a minute.
